REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 09/15/2026
Patient Name: Liam Ellis
DOB: 06/07/1979
MRN: MRN-14876

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Aaron Cole, Cedar Grove Internal Medicine

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiovascular risk before planned elective total knee arthroplasty.

I am writing regarding Liam Ellis, a 47-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. He is scheduled for elective total knee arthroplasty in six weeks and requests cardiovascular risk assessment before surgery.

He reports no chest discomfort, exertional dyspnea, or fainting and walks regularly. Please assess his perioperative cardiovascular risk before the planned procedure.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Aaron Cole
Cedar Grove Internal Medicine
